incomplete_line_policy: Defer all bytes after the last newline; incomplete live progress JSON is never snapshotted. Incomplete required status JSON aborts publication.
integrity_checks: Protocol raw SHA equals required status and all JSON documents carrying protocol_sha256.
Previously exported fixed JSON bytes cannot change.
Log/JSONL previous bytes must remain the exact prefix; only complete lines are appended.
Pilot actual-arm step must be integer contiguous1..2048 with arm identity exact.
Final pilot training_complete log path/bytes/SHA matches exactly2048 complete rows.
Completed pilot retains6144 rows across all3 arms and summary matches arm result records.
Resource benchmark is66 exact ordered rows,22per role,2warmup+20timed; summary binds raw benchmark SHA and completed70/0 counts.
Allowlisted source files cannot be symlinks or resolve outside explicit run; destination symlinks rejected.
UTF8/NUL/nonfinite JSON checks; nonallowlisted files and private asset references are never opened.
limits: This exporter is a text integrity/publication helper, not a scientific gate verifier.
Root training.py writes benchmark_rows.json only after all66 benchmark returns; live progress/failure records preserve current resource accounting.
Metrics/PNG/checkpoint/tensor bytes are never opened or copied.
